title: Unit Event — Our Happy Ending — Episode6 A Show Of Support

meta.Event Outline: Following the successful 30th Anniversary Show, the Wonderlands×Showtime cast feel renewed determination for their respective dreams. Emu, realizing that the troupe will part ways sooner or later, attempts to put on a brave face and say goodbye with a smile. Meanwhile, Rui makes a bold proposition to the Otori brothers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... My eyes are still all red...
Even after putting in those eye drops...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What do I do? If the others see me like this, they're gonna start wondering if I'm okay...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you!
Huh...? Emu, your eyes...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What...?! N-No, I'm fine!
I just... I stayed up all night playing video games!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A-Anyway, MEIKO, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Ah, right!
There's something I need to tell all of you...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... The others should be here soon... But do you want me to relay your message to them?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<You'd do that?
Then, if you don't mind...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Before you all start practicing, we'd like you to come see our show!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We understand with everything that's been going on recently...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But you've all been looking a little down!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What shows need are... Passion! Energy! And above all else, smiles!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Which is why we decided to put on a special show for you all that's guaranteed to turn those frowns upside down!!!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, we'd very much like for you all to see it. So, how about it?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! We'll for sure come see it!
Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, once the others get here, we'll all go over together... Oh, wait...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... You know how my eyes are still a little red? You were worried when you first saw me, MEIKO, so I was wondering if I could do something about it before the others get here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Come with me to SEKAI right now, Emu! I'll invite the others myself!
And while I'm doing that...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, MEIKO asked us to come see this show of theirs, and we're here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: MEIKO said she was here already, but I don't see her anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me neither. Where could she be...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What in the world are you wearing...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She wanted to try it on for a change!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you going to keep wearing that while watching the show? Won't you not be able to see very well...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, it's okay!
It's super easy to see in this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Also, umm...
It's nice and warm in here... And cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A-Anyway, it's okay!
I can see just fine from in here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, and the show's about to start!
Come on everyone, let's go♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
Alright, here we are!
Please take your seats, everyone♪ The show will begin shortly!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like Emu and the others are all here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is to put smiles on all their faces.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's do our best, you guys!!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Once upon a time, there was an eccentric traveling theater troupe♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The troupe consists of a show-offy troupe leader...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And a songstress who can't sing in public!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. They've swapped roles since last time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The oddball group staged many shows, but they never managed to attract an audience!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then one day, as they were traveling through a forest, they encountered an alchemist who was performing a show all alone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see how they're gonna do this!)

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I am a showman, and I could use your help to put on wonderful shows!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I promise that our spectacles will be a joy to see and a joy to perform in!”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line:
“You wish to make shows with me?
I see. I suppose I could help you out a little.”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line: “But will I...find the courage to sing?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line:
“Why were you making shows?
Wasn't it because you wanted to make people happy?”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The showman remembered the first time he saw a theatrical performance, and regretted the way he treated his troupe members.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I've always wanted to become a star like the actors in the first show I saw. I wanted to be a star so that I too could make people as happy as I was then.”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “It was very important to me, but I forgot it along the way. I shall never forget it again!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“What I want is to make people smile.
I want to perform with my troupe again!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. This really takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's as if this all happened just yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (With, “And they made shows together forever after”...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They continued merrily making shows together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But one day, they each began to dream of different things.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The troupe leader wished to become an even bigger star.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The songstress wished to sing all around the world.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The alchemist wished to put on a show that would make anybody and everybody smile.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: ...wished to fill the village where she met her dear friends with smiles and happiness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Each of these dreams was very meaningful to them. Thus, they decided to go their separate ways.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But they also made a promise together.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “One day... One day, when we've all achieved our dreams...”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“Let's meet again here.
To put on another show!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It was only a blink of an eye compared to the span of a person's life. But it must've felt like an eternity to these four...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Fortunately, by the time the clown had built an amusement park that made everybody in the village smile and laugh...

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“Hm? Why the look of surprise?!
I became a world-famous star just like I said I would! You should be happier!”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line:
“I made my dream come true as well!
My singing can reach people all over the world!”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “Hehe. We apologize for appearing so suddenly. Anyway, let's get down to business...”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “What kind of show shall we put on?”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “There's lots and lots of shows that I wanna do with you guys!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our four heroes continued following their various paths in life, but reunited as a troupe that would gather once again at the clown's amusement park from time to time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And they made shows together forever after...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The us in this show were able to do shows together again after saying goodbye.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, I'm sure of it. Someday, we'll...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
That was such a wonderhoy ending...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Thank goodness they let me wear this costume...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was a super amazing show, you guys! Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make our show just as sparkly and fun as the one we saw today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have to make our show one that will make everyone smile.
